children: GoldMining reported interim financials showing a $14.1 million net loss for Q3 and consolidation of U.S. GoldMining results.
Filed unaudited condensed consolidated interim financials and MD&A for Q3 and nine months ended Aug 31, 2026, attached as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2.
Consolidated net loss for the three months ended Aug 31, 2026 was $14.1M (loss per share $0.05); operating loss $14.9M.
Total assets were $210.5M as at Aug 31, 2026; working capital was $46.6M and cash & equivalents $16.7M.
Recorded $20.0M unrealized loss on investments (nine months) and remeasurement impacts including deferred tax adjustments.
Reclassified U.S. GoldMining warrants retrospectively to derivative liabilities; GoldMining controls and consolidates U.S. GoldMining (holds ~70.9%).
